summary: Created `desk:apps:book`; verified typing, Backspace, Enter saving, and reopening with “Alice” displayed.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest Book'
task start()
set names to []
when exists('desk:guestbook')
set names to lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
done
give {names: names, typed: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
when k is 'backspace'
when count(s.typed) > 0
set s.typed to slice(s.typed, 1, count(s.typed) - 1)
done
or when k is 'enter'
when s.typed is not ''
add('desk:guestbook', s.typed)
add s.typed to s.names
set s.typed to ''
done
otherwise
when count(k) is 1
set s.typed to edit_text(s.typed, k)
done
done
give s
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, count(s.names) & ' guests')
for each n in range(1, min(20, count(s.names)))
show(2 + n, 1, item(s.names, count(s.names) - n + 1))
done
show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.typed)
done
